content_markdown:
# [Shared Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/shared-room/)

[Shared Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_shared_PV_1170x660.jpg)

Shared traditional rooms—double occupancy—are found in [Place Vanier](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/place-vanier/ "Place Vanier") and [Totem Park](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/totem-park/ "Totem Park") where on a standard floor 25–30 residents share communal bathrooms\. [Orchard Commons](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/orchard-commons/), [Place Vanier](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/place-vanier/ "Place Vanier") and [Totem Park](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/totem-park/ "Totem Park") also have shared rooms with a shared private bathroom\.

**First Year \| Winter Session \| Mandatory Meal Plan**

# [Connected Single Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/connected-single-room/)

[Connected Single Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_single_connected_TP_1170x660.jpg)

Connected single rooms are located in [Totem Park](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/totem-park/ "Totem Park") and [Orchard Commons](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/orchard-commons)\. Rooms connect by a bathroom that is shared between two residents \(single gender\)\. On a standard floor, 40 residents share a common area\.

**First Year \| Winter Session \| Mandatory Meal Plan**

# [Single Traditional Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/single-traditional-room/)

[Shared Traditional Room](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_single_PV_1170x6601.jpg)

Single rooms are found in [Totem Park](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/totem-park/ "Totem Park") and [Place Vanier](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/place-vanier/ "Place Vanier") \(first year residences\)\. On a standard floor, 25\-30 residents share communal bathrooms\.

**First Year \| Winter Session \| Mandatory Meal Plan**

# [Six Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/six-bedroom/)

[Six Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room-Detail_6BR_female_FH_1170x660.jpg)

Six bedroom suites are available for Winter Session, Year Round and Summer Session\. Students seeking Summer Residence are placed in [Fairview Crescent](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/fairview-crescent/ "Fairview Crescent")\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students  
****Winter Session \| Summer Session \| Year Round**

# [Four Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/four-bedroom-suite/)

[Four Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_4BR_room_RU_1170x660.jpg)

Four bedroom suites have many different layouts and are available for Winter Session and Year Round\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Winter Session \| Year Round**

# [Three Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/three-bedroom-suite/)

[Three Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_3BR_studygroup_MD_1170x660.jpg)

Three bedroom suites have many different layouts and are available for Winter Session and Year Round\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Winter Session \| Year Round**

# [Two Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/two-bedroom-suite/)

[Two Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_2BR_living_PC_1170x660.jpg)

Two bedroom suites have many different layouts and are available for Winter Session and Year Round\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Winter Session \| Year Round**

# [One Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/one-bedroom-suite/)

[One Bedroom Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/Room_detail_1bdrm_lounge_GA_1170x660.jpg)

One bedroom suites have many different layouts—from open concept to split\-level—and are available for Winter Session and Year Round\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Winter Session \| Year Round**

# [Studio Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/studio-suite/)

[Studio](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/Room_detail_studio3_PC_1170x660.jpg)

Designed to maximize space, this all\-in\-one room has a designated kitchen, study space and living/sleeping area\. Studio suites are found in many residences and are available for Winter Session and Year Round\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Winter Session \| Year Round**

# [Nano Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/nano/)

[Nano Suite](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Exchange-Nano-Header.jpg)

Nano suites are a unique room type at UBC, designed for the student who wants a room to suit their minimalist lifestyle\. Nanos pack a convertible desk/bed, full private bathroom, kitchenette and closet into a small but streamlined space\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Year Round**

# [Townhouse](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/townhouse/)

[Townhouse](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Exchange-Townhouse-Header.jpg)

Townhouses are two\-bedroom year round units in [Exchange](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/exchange/)\. They are located at ground level along Wesbrook Mall and Student Union Boulevard\.

**Upper Year \| Graduate Students \|** **Year Round**

# [Accessible Rooms  
and Suites](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/accessible-rooms-and-suites/)

[Accessible Rooms and Suites](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/DSC00948.jpg)

Each residence at UBC offers a number of rooms with accessible room layouts and accessibility features—and we assign eligible students to residences and rooms with the most current features\. 

**All years \| All sessions**

title: Roommate Assignments
content_markdown:
**Meeting and living with new people is one of the best parts about university living\.**

If you don’t request any roommates, you can anticipate living with other students who are around the same age and identify as the same gender—or identify as non\-binary and indicated a preference for a single gender room or suite for students who identify as either women or men\.

We also do our best to pair roommates who report similar lifestyle habits on the application form, but we can’t make guarantees\.

Learn more about [how we assign rooms](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/how-we-assign-rooms/) and learn more about [housing options and gender](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/prospective/gender-diverse/residences-rooms/#housing-options-gender)\.

## How do I contact my roommates before move\-in?

Use the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/) to contact your roommates before move\-in\.

## Roommate requests

### Apply online

Students can request to live together but we cannot guarantee requests will be accommodated\. Roommate requests work best when you follow these steps:

1.  [Submit](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/) all applications on the same date—with identical preferences \(residence area, room type\)\. In the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/), apply under Prospective Residents >> Application >> Apply\.
2.  Include each other’s student ID numbers\.

#### Winter Session applicants

Submit roommate requests before the deadline listed on [Important Dates](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\.

#### Year Round applicants

Each person must choose the same move in date\.

## Get tips for living with roommates

Discover our tips for living with roommates, including ways to get to know each other, how to manage conflict and more\. Plus, download a Roommate Agreement Form and Unit Cleaning Schedule to help you and your roommates discuss shared living expectations\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/living-with-roomates/)

title: Community Living
content_markdown:
Living in a community as large and complex as UBC residence makes it particularly important to know your rights and responsibilities, understand how to have successful roommate relationships and make sure you maintain the cleanliness and condition or your room/unit\.

## Rights and responsibilities

Find out everything you need to know about your rights and responsibilities as a member of the UBC residence community\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rights-and-responsibilities/)

## Living with roommates

Don’t miss these tried and true tips for living with roommates, including how to get to know each other, managing conflict and more\. Plus, access helpful downloadable resources\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/living-with-roomates/)

## Unit inspections

Once per term, Student Housing performs inspections of each residence unit\. Find out how to prepare and how the process works\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/unit-inspections/)

title: Move Out Weekend
content_markdown:
***The information on this page is for residents whose contracts are ending at 12 pm on April 26, 2026 and they are moving out before or on April 26\.***

Thanks so much for living with us in residence at UBC this year\! We hope that your final exams and assignments went well and that you’re looking forward to summer\.

Prepare for Move Out

[Plan your move and avoid last\-minute moving chaos](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/moving-out/) by ensuring that rooms and shared spaces are left as clean as you’d want them if you were moving in\.

## Last day in residence: April 26

While many residents will move out earlier in April, once their exams are complete, some residents stay until the final days in their residence contract\.

-   Last day in residence: **April 26, 2026**
-   Check out time: **no later than 12 pm \(noon\)**—please arrive by 11:30 am to avoid lineups and ensure that you can complete the check out process by noon\.

You must clean your unit, remove all of your items and move out BEFORE 12 pm on Sunday, April 26 unless you have an approved residence contract extension \(i\.e\., you are moving into Year Round residence\)\.

**Pro tip:** Check out before 10 am to avoid the lineups\!

## How to check\-out?

Follow these instructions to make your check out process as smooth and efficient as possible\.

### Your check\-out to\-do list

To complete the check out procedures, please ensure you do all of the following:

-   **Remove all your belongings from your room/unit**, including any bikes stored outside\!\*
-   **Dispose of all trash, food and recycling**—and anything you still need to donate at your [nearest donation zone](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/moving-out/)\!
-   **Clean your unit**\.
-   **Close and lock all windows and doors**\.
-   **Return your keys and check out**—at your residence front desk or, during limited hours, at a centrally\-located check\-out table near your front desk or commonsblock\.
-   **Set up letter mail forwarding in the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/)**\. If you do not set up mail forwarding, any mail or packages that we receive after you check out will be returned to sender\.
    -   Fairview Crescent residents: [Contact Canada Post](https://www.canadapost-postescanada.ca/cpc/en/home.page) to forward mail\. Note: This service is not available for packages\.

Remember to bring all your keys\! You’ll be charged a fee on your residence account for any keys you don’t return\.

\*Any bikes left behind at Winter Session residence areas are removed and donated to [The Bike Kitchen](https://www.thebikekitchen.ca/)\.

[Cleaning and departure checklists](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/moving-out/cleaning-departure/)

### When can I check out?

-   **April 25 and earlier:** check out during regular front desk hours, 7 am–11 pm\. Please arrive at the front desk by 10:30 pm to ensure that you can complete the check out process before the front desk closes\.
-   **April 26:** check out between 7 am and 12 pm \(noon\)\. Please arrive at the front desk by 11:30 am to ensure that you can complete the check out process by noon\.

Given the high volume of final check\-outs on April 26, please arrive early and expect some lineups\.

#### **Can I check out overnight?**

Please check out during front desk hours, 7 am–11 pm\.

If you plan to leave overnight, when the front desk is closed, please check out before 11 pm—and you are welcome to remain in the commonsblock until you leave campus\.

### Can I borrow a luggage cart?

You can borrow a luggage cart for maximum 20 minutes, between 7 am and 11 pm, when the front desk is open\.

To borrow a luggage cart:

-   Visit the cart check\-out table near your residence front desk\.
-   Leave one piece of Photo ID and your phone number\.

Please note that carts will be in high demand\.

Reminder to set up mail forwarding\!

Before you move out, make sure to set up mail forwarding in the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/)\. \(Fairview Crescent residents: contact [Canada Post](http://www.canadapost.ca/) to forward mail\.\)  
If you do not set up mail forwarding, any mail or packages that we receive after you check out will be returned to sender\.

### Moving out with a vehicle?

If you will be using a vehicle to move out on April 26, follow the arrival instructions provided below to get to the correct loading zone for your residence area and/or building\.

On April 26, we’ll also have helpful signage and friendly staff in place to help you find your way\.

You will be able to temporarily park and load up close to the residence area \(max 20 minutes\), and then if you plan to stay on campus afterward, you will need to park at a nearby parkade, as indicated below\.

Please note that all parking rules and signage are in effect\. Parking in fire lanes or “authorized vehicles only” spaces and roads may result in a ticket if you are moving out any day other than April 26\.

#### Vehicle arrival instructions

Brock Commons and Iona House

Vehicles arriving to Brock Commons and Iona House should plan to enter [Walter Gage Road from Wesbrook Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B016%2714.9%22N+123%C2%B014%2753.2%22W/@49.270808,-123.2493871,18z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.270808!4d-123.248097?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\. From there they will be directed by staff to the nearest loading zone\.

Vehicles parking in loading zones around Brock Commons and Walter Gage Residences can only do so for up to 20 minutes\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [North Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/North+Parkade,+6115+Student+Union+Blvd,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2690299,-123.2693546,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b73706caa3:0xd77ae7269d911497!8m2!3d49.2690314!4d-123.2509222!16s%2Fg%2F1v9gv4hg?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\.

Exchange, tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ and Walter Gage

Vehicles arriving to Exchange Residence and tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ should plan to enter [Student Union Boulevard from Wesbrook Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B016%2709.2%22N+123%C2%B014%2752.2%22W/@49.269232,-123.2484701,19z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.269232!4d-123.247825?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\. From there they will be directed by staff to the nearest loading zone\.

Vehicles parking in loading zones around Exchange, tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ and Walter Gage Residences can only do so for up to 20 minutes\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [North Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/North+Parkade,+6115+Student+Union+Blvd,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2690299,-123.2693546,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b73706caa3:0xd77ae7269d911497!8m2!3d49.2690314!4d-123.2509222!16s%2Fg%2F1v9gv4hg?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\.

Fairview

Vehicles arriving to Fairview Residence will only be able to enter via the [South entrance to Fairview Crescent service road located off of Fairview Avenue](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2745.1%22N+123%C2%B014%2719.5%22W/@49.262537,-123.2393951,19z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.262537!4d-123.23875?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), near the Acadia Park Commonsblock\.

*Vehicle traffic will not be permitted to enter from Agronomy Road\.*

Vehicles entering Fairview Residence will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

Then, if you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [North Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/North+Parkade,+6115+Student+Union+Blvd,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2690299,-123.2693546,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b73706caa3:0xd77ae7269d911497!8m2!3d49.2690314!4d-123.2509222!16s%2Fg%2F1v9gv4hg?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) or [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) which will have free parking from 8 am through 1 pm on April 26\. Pay parking is also available at the nearby [Thunderbird Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Thunderbird+Parkade,+6085+Thunderbird+Blvd,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC+V6T+1Z3/@49.2615983,-123.245617,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672c8d8f8a955:0x266113c010157784!8m2!3d49.2615983!4d-123.2430367!16s%2Fg%2F1tf818sn?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Fraser Hall

Vehicles arriving at Fraser Hall can temporarily park on [Wesbrook Mall in the loading spaces directly in front of the building](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2741.1%22N+123%C2%B014%2728.0%22W/@49.2608035,-123.2411998,18z/data=!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.261413!4d-123.241106?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Vehicles parking in front of Fraser Hall will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

Then, if you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [North Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/North+Parkade,+6115+Student+Union+Blvd,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2690299,-123.2693546,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b73706caa3:0xd77ae7269d911497!8m2!3d49.2690314!4d-123.2509222!16s%2Fg%2F1v9gv4hg?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) or [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\. Pay parking is also available at the nearby [Thunderbird Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Thunderbird+Parkade,+6085+Thunderbird+Blvd,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC+V6T+1Z3/@49.2615983,-123.245617,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672c8d8f8a955:0x266113c010157784!8m2!3d49.2615983!4d-123.2430367!16s%2Fg%2F1tf818sn?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Marine Drive

Due to the construction around your residence area, parking is extremely limited\. We recommend that you utilize levels 1 and 4 of the [West Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hJC2k2AzcYrSGyKw5)\. There are no elevators in the parkade, but these levels are accessible for carts from the street level\. Parking at the West Parkade will be free from 8 am to 11 pm on April 26\.

Orchard Commons

Vehicles arriving to Orchard Commons for loading can arrive at the [B4 parking lot](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Parking+lot,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC/@49.2604199,-123.2502716,17z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548673d0183a7fd9:0xa00cbdd91c14df!2sUBC+B4+Lot!8m2!3d49.2613371!4d-123.2457118!16s%2Fg%2F11j4xgtlk_!3m5!1s0x548672cb979342af:0xebccec7d9532e6f3!8m2!3d49.2597814!4d-123.2499488!16s%2Fg%2F11cph58yyk?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), across the street on Agronomy Road, which will have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\.

Vehicles parking in the B4 lot will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will also have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\.

Ponderosa Commons

Vehicles arriving to Ponderosa Commons should drive south on West Mall, and then will be directed to [turn right onto University Boulevard \(one way traffic\)](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2750.1%22N+123%C2%B015%2718.1%22W/@49.263928,-123.2563111,18z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.263928!4d-123.255021?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Vehicles parking outside Ponderosa Commons will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am to 1 pm on April 26\.

-   For students living in MacKenzie, Ross, Mawdsley, Korea\-UBC, Tec de Monterrey, Cariboo, Robson, Tweedsmuir, Sherwood Lett and Kootenay Houses, arrive at the [one\-way service road entrance located off of Lower Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2757.3%22N+123%C2%B015%2731.4%22W/@49.265925,-123.2593521,179m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.265925!4d-123.258707?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.
-   For students living in Okanagan House, arrive at the [C\-Lot parking lot located off of Lower Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2753.4%22N+123%C2%B015%2727.6%22W/@49.2647463,-123.2579906,179m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.26483!4d-123.257675?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Ritsumeikan\-UBC House

Vehicles arriving at Ritsumeikan\-UBC House should arrive at the [main entrance to Totem Park off of West Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2730.6%22N+123%C2%B015%2702.7%22W/@49.258485,-123.2520351,357m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.258485!4d-123.250743?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\. Totem Park

Vehicles arriving at Totem Park should arrive as follows:

-   **All houses—except həm̓ləsəm̓ and q̓ələχən:** arrive at the [main entrance to Totem Park off of West Mall](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2730.6%22N+123%C2%B015%2702.7%22W/@49.258485,-123.2520351,357m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.258485!4d-123.250743?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\. From there, they will be directed by staff depending on the specific house\.
-   **həm̓ləsəm̓ and q̓ələχən:** Arrive and park on [West Mall in front of həm̓ləsəm̓ and q̓ələχən houses](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2733.4%22N+123%C2%B015%2704.8%22W/@49.259274,-123.2519781,179m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.259274!4d-123.251333?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

Vehicles arriving at Totem Park will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am through 1 pm on April 26\.

Thunderbird

Vehicles arriving to Thunderbird Residence should plan to enter the residence area \(i\.e\., Thunderbird Crescent\) from [Thunderbird Boulevard](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2732.9%22N+123%C2%B014%2756.0%22W/@49.2590357,-123.2498851,179m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d49.259125!4d-123.248882?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQxMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), since West Mall will be very busy with students moving out of Totem Park\.

Vehicles arriving at Thunderbird will have 20 minutes maximum for loading\.

If you need to remain on campus after loading your vehicle, you can move it to the [West Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+West+Parkade/@49.2617065,-123.2585874,16z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!2sUBC+West+Parkade!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y!3m5!1s0x548672ca8395049f:0xa4e00a1b8ebfa1a8!8m2!3d49.2626027!4d-123.255063!16s%2Fg%2F11c57wwp_y?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQwOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), which will have free parking from 8 am through 1 pm on April 26\.

title: Lower Mall Precinct Project
content_markdown:
[Lower Mall Precinct Project Aerial Rendering \| September 2025](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Lower-Mall-Precinct-Project-Aerial-Rendering-September-2025.jpg)

In August 2024, SHCS, UBC and the Province of BC [announced a major partnership](https://news.ubc.ca/2024/08/government-funding-brings-more-affordable-ubc-campus-housing/) to build a new student residence complex in the Lower Mall Precinct, on the current site of St\. John’s College\.

The Lower Mall Precinct \(LMP\) project will address the growing demand for student housing by building approximately 1,500 graduate student focused beds \(1,325 new and 175 replacement beds\)\.

Designed by [Ryder Architecture](https://www.ryderarchitecture.com/) \+ [3XN](https://3xn.com/) and developed together with [UBC Properties Trust](https://ubcproperties.com/) and [UBC Campus \+ Community Planning](https://planning.ubc.ca/), the project reflects UBC and SHCS’s commitment to [Campus Vision 2050](https://planning.ubc.ca/vision), UBC’s [Housing Action Plan](https://hr.ubc.ca/working-ubc/housing-immigration-and-relocation-services/housing-programs/housing-action-plan) and our goals to enhance campus life and support students by providing exceptional, on\-campus student housing, food services and child care\.

## Key features

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Student Housing room types:** Numerous room types will be available, including studios \(with kitchens\), studios \(without kitchens\), one bedroom, two bedroom and four bedroom units\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Dining hall:** This project will feature a dining hall for residents and the wider community\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Child care:** Like other recent student housing developments, this project will include a child care setting \(37 spaces\)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Environmental sustainability and climate:** This project will incorporate many energy\-saving features to significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions and will be built to LEED Gold standards\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Community:** By including amenities for student residents and the wider community, we’ll enhance this increasingly vibrant area of campus and create opportunities for community and connection\.

## Project status and details

### Project timeline

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**May 2026:** St\. John’s College Fellows move out or transfer to a unit in another residence on\-campus and site decommissioning begins\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**Fall 2026:** Construction of new buildings begins\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)**2028–2029:** Students move in—in stages between 2028 and 2029 as buildings are completed\.

### Financial sustainability

The Government of British Columbia is contributing more than $300 million to this $560 million project in a combination of loan and grants\. The balance of the investment comes from UBC internal loans\. The financial support from the province means that we can ensure sustainable rents for future generations of UBC students, at this residence and at existing residences\.

[Old Fire Hall](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/oldfirehall-10-1024x768.jpg)

## The 98\-year\-old that stopped traffic

On November 14, 2024, UBC’s historic Old Fire Hall, built in 1926, was [carefully lifted from its foundation and relocated](https://news.ubc.ca/2024/11/ubc-historic-fire-hall-moves/)—to preserve its heritage for future generations\. The building is currently parked at a temporary home on\-campus until its permanent relocation as part of the Lower Mall Precinct project\.

## Learn more

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)[Transformative partnership brings 1,500 new student beds to UBC Vancouver](https://news.ubc.ca/2024/08/government-funding-brings-more-affordable-ubc-campus-housing/)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)[Lower Mall Precinct Phase 1 \(UBC Campus \+ Community Planning\)](https://planning.ubc.ca/LMP_Phase1)

### Plans and reports

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)[Architectural plans](https://planning.ubc.ca/sites/default/files/2025-05/UBC%20Lower%20Mall_ARCH_Issued%20for%20Development%20Permit_250429_compressed_Sealed.pdf)

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/)[Arborist report and tree survey](https://planning.ubc.ca/sites/default/files/2025-05/250414_DHC%20TMPs%20and%20Arborist%20Report_Lower%20Mall%20Precinct%20and%20St%20Johns%20College%2C%20UBC_DRAFT.pdf)

## Summary

Six bedroom suites are available for Winter Session, Year Round, and Summer Session\. Students seeking Summer Residence are placed in [Fairview Crescent](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences/fairview-crescent/ "Fairview Crescent")\.

-   Furnished
-   Shared kitchen and bathrooms
-   [High\-speed internet access](https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/resnet)
-   [Bed linens](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/bed-linens/ "Bed Linens") not included
-   Photos/layouts are samples only—suites vary by location

### Furnishings

Twin XL \(extra long\) bed, wardrobe, dresser, desk, lamp, chairs, bookshelf, closet, couches, and tables\. Amenities vary by location\.

Many residences and rooms have modern [sustainability features](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/services-amenities/sustainability-features/ "Sustainability Features") designed to reduce waste, energy consumption, and water use\.

title: Indigenous Names
content_markdown:
[Photo of UBC sign in front of glass windows\. Blue and grey UBC building sign with white text that reads tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ \(The Houses of the Ones Belonging to Saltwater", qʷta:yθən leləm̓ \(Sturgeon House\), Residence Front Desk, 5955 Student Union Boulevard\.](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Sturgeon-House-sign-Saltwater-2400x1600-1.jpg)

**In SHCS, we are grateful to have worked directly with the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm \(Musqueam\) Nation since 2011 on several student residence projects, for which they generously gifted hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓\-language names\.**

Learn more about and how to pronounce the gifted hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓\-language residence and house names, read about the history of  Indigenous names at Totem Park, and explore the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm plants located at many of our residence areas and across campus\.

## tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ

Learn more about and how to pronounce the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm names at at tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ student residence\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/houses-of-ones-belonging-to-saltwater-names/)

## Totem Park

Find out about the Indigenous Names at Totem Park, including the three houses with gifted hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓\-language names and the six heritage houses\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/house-names/)

## xʷməθkʷəy̓əm plants

Explore the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm plants located at tə šxʷhəleləm̓s tə k̓ʷaƛ̓kʷəʔaʔɬ and across campus\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/musqueam-plants/)

## Learn more

xʷməθkʷəy̓əm \(Musqueam\)

Read [xʷməθkʷəy̓əm’s story](https://www.musqueam.bc.ca/our-story/) and find [educational resources](https://www.musqueam.bc.ca/our-story/educational-resources/)\.

**Learn how to pronounce xʷməθkʷəy̓əm**

[Embedded audio \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/indigenous-names/)[Media source](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam-name-pronunciation.mp3?_=32)[https://vancouver\.housing\.ubc\.ca/wp\-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam\-name\-pronunciation\.mp3](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam-name-pronunciation.mp3)

hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓

**Learn how to pronounce hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓**

[Embedded audio \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/indigenous-names/)[Media source](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam-language-name-pronunciation.mp3?_=33)[https://vancouver\.housing\.ubc\.ca/wp\-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam\-language\-name\-pronunciation\.mp3](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Musqueam-language-name-pronunciation.mp3)

### Additional resources

Access these additional resources, learning opportunities and more—at UBC and beyond\.

-   [Indigenous foundations](https://indigenousfoundations.arts.ubc.ca/home/)—an information resource on key topics relating to the histories, politics, and cultures of the Aboriginal peoples of Canada\.
-   [UBC Indigenous Portal](https://indigenous.ubc.ca/)
-   [The Power of a Name](https://powerofaname.ubc.ca/)
-   [First Peoples: a Guide for Newcomers](https://vancouver.ca/files/cov/First-Peoples-A-Guide-for-Newcomers.pdf)
-   [xʷməθkʷəy̓əm street signs at UBC](https://planning.ubc.ca/transportation/transportation-planning/musqueam-street-signs)
-   [šxʷməθkʷəy̓əmasəm Street](https://vancouver.ca/people-programs/musqueamview-st.aspx)—City of Vancouver
-   [Weaving Relations](https://apsc.ubc.ca/weaving-relations)—a self\-directed course for UBC students developed jointly by the Faculty of Applied Science and the Faculty of Land and Food Systems\.
-   [Indigenous Canada](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/online-courses/indigenous-canada/index.html)—a 12\-lesson Massive Open Online Course \(MOOC\) from the University of Alberta that explores the different histories and contemporary perspectives of Indigenous peoples living in Canada\.
-   [First Nations Unicode keyboard and font](https://cis.arts.ubc.ca/community/first-nations-unicode-font/)—use this custom desktop keyboard and font to display characters from First Nations languages\.
-   First Voices keyboard \([Apple](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/firstvoices-keyboards/id1066651145) \| [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.firstvoices.keyboards&hl=en_CA&pli=1)\)—download the free FirstVoices Keyboard to type in Indigenous languages on your phone or tablet\.

title: Accessibility in Residence
content_markdown:
[A group of students gathered at Ponderosa Commons](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/accessibility-in-residence-2000x1083-1-1024x554.jpg)

**At UBC and in Student Housing and Community Services, we are committed to providing supportive and inclusive living and learning environments with resources, services and supports for students with disabilities or ongoing medical conditions\.**

Each residence at UBC offers a number of rooms with accessible room layouts and accessibility features\. Depending on availability, we do our best to offer eligible students housing that will meet their disability\-related housing needs\.

Additionally, the majority of residence buildings at UBC also have barrier\-free entry and accessible common areas, including commonsblocks, house and floor lounges, and washrooms\.

## On this page

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Accessible student housing options](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#options)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Eligibility for accessible student housing](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#eligibility)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Apply for accessible student housing](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#apply)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[FAQs](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#faqs)

[Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)

### Accessible rooms and suites

[Check out photos and learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/accessible-rooms-and-suites/) about our accessible rooms and suites: accessibility features, furnishings and more\. Plus, take a [virtual tour](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-virtual-tours/#accessible)\.

## Accessible student housing options

Depending on the nature of a student’s disability or chronic health condition, they may qualify for one of three categories of accessible student housing:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**A fully accessible room/unit**—for students who require more comprehensive accessibility features and a fully accessible room/unit layout\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**A standard room outfitted with relevant accessibility features**—for students who require accessibility features that can be incorporated into a standard room, such as a visual fire alarm\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**A standard room/unit**—for students who have a disability\-related need to live on campus, but not for specific accessibility features or room/unit layouts\.

### Residence and room assignments

If you are approved for one of these three categories of accessible student housing, you will be offered an appropriate room in any residence where you are [eligible to live](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/)\.

While we will consider the preferences you listed in your application, placement in a specific residence is ultimately based on availability\.

As mentioned above, if you require specific accessibility features or room/unit layouts, we will do our best to place you in one with the most current layout and features\.

[Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)

### Living on campus: vibrant, but sometimes noisy

Living in residence at UBC is a communal living experience\.  
  
In many instances, living in residence includes shared or close\-proximity accommodation, communal dining and vibrant, but busy spaces with limited noise control\.  
  
Students have limited choice regarding the residence and room type where they are assigned\. We encourage you to consider these factors when deciding whether or not to apply for student housing\.

## Eligibility for accessible student housing

To be eligible for accessible student housing, your disability or chronic health condition must present significant functional limitations, which:

a\) reduces your housing options and/or  
b\) requires you to live on campus to equitably access the full academic experience\.

View examples of [eligible applications](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#eligible-examples) for accessible student housing and [examples of conditions that are typically not eligible](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/#ineligible-examples)\.

### Additional eligibility requirements

Visit [eligibility](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/) to ensure you meet the all of the eligibility requirements for living in residence\.

#### Apply for UBC and residence on time

In addition to the primary [eligibility requirements](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/), you need to apply for UBC and residence on time\.

***First Year residence applicants: Winter Session residence***

If you are a future first year UBC student, to be eligible for accessible Winter Session student housing \(September–April\), you must apply and accept your offer of admission to UBC on time, as follows:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**Residence Application deadline:** you must submit your application for residence by May 1\.\*
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**UBC admissions offer acceptance deadline:** you must receive and accept UBC’s offer of academic admission by June 1\.

*\*Submit your residence application and your application for accessible housing as soon as you apply for admission to UBC, or shortly afterwards—and no later than the May 1 deadline\. You do not need to wait until you’ve received an offer of academic admission from UBC\.*

***Upper Year residence applicants: year round residence***

If you are a new or returning upper year residence applicant, to be eligible, you must accept your residence offer by the deadline stated in your offer email\.

### Examples of eligible applications for accessible student housing

Approval for accessible housing is not guaranteed\. It is based on demonstrated need, rather than preference, and there must be a clear, direct and logical link between your disability or condition and the type of accessible student housing you request in the application\.

To help you determine if you might be eligible for accessible student housing, here are some examples of eligible scenarios:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**Mobility limitations:** a student who uses a wheelchair or has another major mobility limitation and requires a wheelchair accessible room\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**Functional limitations:** a student who has functional limitations and requires a room with direct access to a bathroom\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)**Service animal support:** a student with a visual impairment, and a registered service animal, who requires housing that offers easy wayfinding and clear pathways\.

### Conditions that are typically not eligible

Approval for accessible housing is not guaranteed\. It is based on demonstrated need, rather than preference, and there must be a clear, direct and logical link between your disability or condition and the type of accessible student housing you request in the application\.

While not always, the following disorders or conditions typically do not present limitations that require accessible student housing:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)ADHD
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Anxiety or depression
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Learning disabilities, such as dyslexia or dyscalculia
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Sensitivity to noise
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Mild asthma or allergies
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Food allergies/dietary needs—which for first year residents on the residence meal plan are typically addressed through dining accommodations, rather than housing assignment changes\. Read more about [nutritional support](https://food.ubc.ca/meal-plans/residence-meal-plan-all-access-dining/#nutrition) and [how Food Services accommodates dietary restrictions](https://food.ubc.ca/meal-plans/residence-meal-plan-all-access-dining/#faqs)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Short\-term injuries \(i\.e\., broken bones\)

However, for some of the above conditions, a student may be eligible for accommodations related to academic coursework, which can be applied for by registering with the [Centre for Accessibility](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/registering-centre-accessibility/)\.

#### Am I eligible to bring a registered service animal to residence?

Registered service animals are welcome in residence at UBC\. If you require the support of a registered service animal, you do not need to request approval to bring them\. However, please indicate that information when submitting the [Accessible Student Housing Request Form](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/accessible-housing-for-students-with-disabilities/#how-to-apply)\.

Letting the Centre for Accessibility know about your registered service animal at the time of application means we can ensure ahead of time that a residence and room/unit you may be offered is equipped with features that support your and your service animal’s needs\.

Please note that registered service animals differ from emotional support animals\. To inquire about emotional support animals, please [contact us](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/)\.

#### What about financial limitations or difficulty finding a place to rent?

While we acknowledge the challenges associated with the challenging rental market and the financial barriers that students may experience in [renting off\-campus](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/other-housing/off-campus-housing/), these scenarios are not unique to students with disabilities or chronic health conditions\. As such, those factors are not part of the evaluation process for accessible student housing\.

## Apply for accessible student housing

### How to apply for accessible student housing

Follow these steps to apply for accessible student housing:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Download a copy of the [Accessible Student Housing Medical Assessment Form](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/accessible-housing-for-students-with-disabilities/#how-to-apply) and have it completed by a registered physician, nurse practitioner, psychologist or other qualified medical professional with the credentials to diagnose and prescribe treatment\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)Complete the UBC Centre for Accessibility’s [Accessible Student Housing Request Form](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/accessible-housing-for-students-with-disabilities/#how-to-apply)—and attach your completed copy of the Accessible Student Housing Medical Assessment Form\.

### When to apply for accessible student housing

Submit your application for accessible housing at the same time you apply to UBC or promptly afterward\. Ensure you apply for residence by the [relevant deadline](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\.

### How and when will I find out if I qualify?

Once you submit the Accessible Student Housing Request Form \(with the Medical Assessment Form attached\) your request will be reviewed by the Centre for Accessibility—and within four to six weeks they’ll email you to let you know if you qualify \(i\.e\., if they will be providing a recommendation to us\)\.

## FAQs

### Which office determines if a student is eligible for accessible student housing?

UBC’s [Centre for Accessibility](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/) \(CFA\) reviews medical documentation to assess a disability\-related need for  accessible housing\. The CFA then works in close collaboration with Student Housing and, where relevant, other UBC partners to determine a suitable housing placement, based on the student’s needs and the types of accessible rooms/units that are currently available\.

## Additional questions?

Please [contact us](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/) if you have any additional questions about accessibility in residence\.

## Learn more

To learn more about accessibility in residence and UBC, check out the following resources:

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Accessible rooms and suites in residence](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/rooms/accessible-rooms-and-suites/)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Accessibility on campus](https://planning.ubc.ca/transportation/accessibility-campus)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Centre for Accessibility](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/centre-for-accessibility/)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[Academic accommodations for students with disabilities](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/academic-learning-resources/academic-accommodations-disabilities/)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)[UBC Accessibility Hub](https://equity.ubc.ca/resources/accessibility-hub/)

[Image](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Flag-Pole-Check-In-recolour-1024x540.png)

**We can’t wait to welcome you to residence at UBC\!** 👋

Here’s some key information so you know when to arrive, how to get here, how to check in, and how to move into your new room on Move In Day\.

## Arrival and check\-in instructions

For students moving into **Place Vanier** and **Walter Gage**\.

## Move In Day overview

Here’s a brief overview of how the day will go\. More details below\!

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)**Arrive at UBC**—if you’re arriving by vehicle, park for free at the [Rose Garden Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aWHtyWo4UZjkT2an7)\.

If you drove a vehicle, you’ll return to your vehicle then drive to your residence\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)**Move in\!**—if you drove a vehicle, you’ll have 15 minutes to unload, then you’ll re\-park at a different parkade near your residence\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)**Unpack and settle in**—if you drove, walk back to your room, unpack and settle in\! If you need a bite to eat, [find out what’s open on\-campus](https://food.ubc.ca/feedme/)\.

## Move In Day schedule

## Move In Day details

Detailed steps for arriving, checking in and moving into your room on Move In Day, which depend on how you get here\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)[Arriving by vehicle](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/#vehicle)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)[Arriving by taxi or rideshare](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/#taxi-rideshare)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)[Arriving by bus](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/#bus)

### Arriving by vehicle?

GPS is great for getting to UBC, but once you’re close to campus, follow our signs instead\. We’ve posted them at key points all over campus\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Park at the Rose Garden Parkade

Your first stop is the [Rose Garden Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Qoxnm13Gjxuhwpww5), where you’ll **park for free** while you get checked in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Please park on one of the upper levels\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)EV chargers are located on level 5\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Accessible parking stalls are on level 5\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)The elevator is accessible from level 5 only\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Parking in the Rose Garden Parkade is free on September 1 and September 5, 8:30 am–4 pm\. You do not need to register your vehicle\.

**Overheight vehicles:** vehicle clearance in the Rose Garden Parkade is 6’8” \(2\.03m\)\. If your vehicle is taller, park for free at the [Armouries Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r6LxnCxMp6xCPPQV9) instead\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Proceed to Flag Pole Plaza

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Leave your belongings in your car\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Bring your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)To exit the parkade, take either the stairs or the elevator \(accessible from level 5 only\) to the top level\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Exit the stairs or elevator and take a moment to enjoy the view\!
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Then turn around and locate the big white tent—where you’ll check in\.

**Overheight vehicles:** leave your vehicle at the [Armouries Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r6LxnCxMp6xCPPQV9) and [proceed up Crescent Road to Main Mall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fFHeaUbagLkuv1Ft9), where you’ll find the big white tent to check in\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Check in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Come on over to the check\-in tent\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package and vehicle pass\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Get directions to your residence\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Proceed to your residence

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Return to your vehicle and drive your belongings to your residence building\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Follow our directions—and the signs located along your route—to get there\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Move in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Once you arrive at your residence, you’ll have 15 minutes to unload your vehicle and move your belongings to your new room\.  
    
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Moving carts are available to use for free—although a limited supply is available\. To borrow one, you need to leave us with your government\-issued photo ID\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Re\-park your vehicle at a different parkade closer to your residence

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Once you’ve moved your stuff to your room, return to your vehicle\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Place Vanier residents: drive to the [Fraser River Parkade](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Fraser+River+Parkade,+Vancouver,+BC+V6T+1X1/@49.2660393,-123.2580362,1174m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b467ccce8f:0x63305aaac3ee0d7!8m2!3d49.2660393!4d-123.2580362!16s%2Fg%2F1tgjkzvy?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYxNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) and park for the remainder of the day—for free until 11 pm\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Walter Gage residents: drive to the [North Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwhr6aDNLKyjk19Z9) and park for the remainder of the day—for free until 11 pm\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Unpack and settle in

🚀 Mission accomplished\!

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Return to your room\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Unpack\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Visit your commonsblock to check out the UBC Bookstore pop\-up store and pick up any extra supplies you need\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Settle in and make yourself at home\!

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Attend your first meeting—and \(for Place Vanier residents\) dinner at the dining hall

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Attend your first floor meeting with either your Jump Start orientation leader \(Sept\. 1\) or your Residence Advisor \(Sept\. 5\)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Place Vanier: your orientation leader or RA will let you know what time your floor is going to the dining hall, [Gather at Vanier](https://food.ubc.ca/places/gather/), for your first dinner\.

### Arriving by taxi or rideshare?

If you’re arriving by taxi or rideshare \(i\.e\., Uber\), follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Your driver can drop you off at the [UBC Flag Pole on Crescent Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TPVmaCBj7P9hZi5z5)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Locate the big white check\-in tent and come on over\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Walk/roll or take our free shuttle to your residence\.

### Arriving by bus?

If you’re arriving by bus, follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)You’ll arrive at the [UBC Bus Exchange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nqyUrMEU7tsFmZj98) or [trolley bus loop](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+Exchange+@+Bay+10/@49.2658226,-123.2483204,73m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m15!1m8!3m7!1s0x548672b787aa42fd:0x38e3cff4a7d52c2d!2sUBC+Bus+Loop,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC!3b1!8m2!3d49.2678531!4d-123.2477071!16s%2Fg%2F11h7fm177r!3m5!1s0x548672b7cea304d7:0x55ecff169b7e418d!8m2!3d49.26581!4d-123.248129!16s%2Fg%2F11h03z79x?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYxNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), depending on which bus you take\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Proceed to [Flag Pole Plaza](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SY4FUmC6k27DxpPW7): [walk/roll across campus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RPBGHUxwptiHrUBfA) or take the [Route 68 Community Shuttle](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/49.2674775,-123.247755/UBC+Flag+Pole,+Crescent+Road,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.270099,-123.2630386,2348m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m8!4m7!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x548672b1440e6367:0x69a285c6e49b74d2!2m2!1d-123.2561998!2d49.2689209?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYxNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) from the UBC Bus Exchange\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Locate the big white check\-in tent and come on over\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)Walk/roll or take our free shuttle to your residence\.

## FAQs

### Do I need to book a timeslot?

If you’re planning to arrive on one of the two official Move In Days, during the time when our central check\-ins are open, you need to book a timeslot\. Watch for an email from us in August with info about how to book yours\!

### What if I miss my timeslot?

We understand that travel delays can occur\. If you end up arriving later than the move\-in timeslot you booked, but while our central check\-ins are still open, follow the same arrival and check\-in instructions and head to your central check\-in location as planned\.

### What if I arrive late?

You’ll be able to check in at your residence commonsblock starting about 90 minutes after the Flag Pole Plaza check\-in closes: 3 pm closure on Sept\. 1; 2 pm closure on Sept\. 5\.

Please arrive no later than 10:30 pm to check in at your residence commonsblock, to allow time for check\-in before the residence front desk closes at 11 pm sharp\.

If you’re arriving later than 10:30 pm, you’ll need to book a hotel and check\-in the next day \(7:30 am–10:30 pm\)\. On\-campus [hotel accommodation](https://suitesatubc.com/) is available\.

#### Where can I park if I arrive late?

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)**Place Vanier:** park at the [Fraser River Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LoGVGGakpEzarpuNA)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/)**Walter Gage:** park in the [North Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z4iMwgb8udJoCGZa7)\.

### Can I arrive after Move In Day?

Yes, you can arrive on a later date\. Simply check in at your residence front desk, 7:30 am–10:30 pm \(a half hour after opening and a half hour before closing\) seven days a week\.

If you are using a vehicle and moving in on a date other than our two official Move In Days, you can park temporarily in a loading zone near your building while you briefly unload or park/pay at the [nearest parking lot or parkade](https://parking.ubc.ca/)\.

### Can I bring my pet?

While we love animals, pets are not permitted in residence\. Please leave your pet at home\.

### What if I forget to bring something?

UBC Bookstore also has plenty of [residence supplies](https://the.bookstore.ubc.ca/home--lifestyle/categories/residence-supplies) in stock, for purchase online or in\-store\.

## Questions?

Check out the complete [Move In Day guide](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)\. If you have additional questions that aren’t answered there, please email [move\.in\.day@ubc\.ca](mailto:move.in.day@ubc.ca)\.
