**9 am–2 pm**

### Check\-in time slots

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)You’ll need to book a specific check\-in time slot if you’re moving in on one of these dates\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Watch for an email from us in early to mid\-August with info about how to book yours\.

## Move In Day overview

Here’s a brief overview of how the day will go\. More details below\!

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Arrive at UBC**—if you’re arriving by vehicle, park at the [Thunderbird Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MtCFCmsaKex5gWuB7)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Check in**—check in at the [Life Sciences Centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PJy1cfuVdYFpnUd97) \(also known as the Life Sciences Institute\)\. If you’re taking a taxi or uber, set your drop off location to [6130 Agronomy Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DBcxHwDFomp38EXf9) for easy access to the Life Sciences Centre\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Proceed to your residence**—at check\-in we’ll give you a map with directions to your residence\. If you drove a vehicle, you’ll return to your vehicle then drive to your residence\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Move in\!**—if you drove a vehicle, you’ll have 15 minutes to unload\. Then you’ll re\-park at the [Thunderbird Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MtCFCmsaKex5gWuB7)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Unpack and settle in**—if you drove, walk back to your room, unpack and settle in\! If you need a bite to eat, [find out what’s open on\-campus](https://food.ubc.ca/feedme/)\.

## Move In Day schedule

### September 1 schedule

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**9 am:** Check\-in at Life Sciences Centre opens\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**3 pm:** Check\-in at Life Sciences Centre closes\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**4:30 pm \(approximately\):** Check\-in re\-opens at your residence commonsblock\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**10:30 pm:** Latest arrival for check\-in at residence front desks\.\*
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**11 pm:** Residence front desks close\.

### September 5 schedule

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**9 am:** Check\-in at Life Sciences Centre opens\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**2 pm:** Check\-in at Life Sciences Centre closes\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**3:30 pm \(approximately\):** Check\-in re\-opens at your residence commonsblock\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**10:30 pm:** Latest arrival for check\-in at residence front desks\.\*
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**11 pm:** Residence front desks close\.

**\*If you’re arriving after 10:30 pm**, you’ll need to book a hotel and check in the next day between 7:30 am and 10:30 pm\. On\-campus [hotel accommodation](https://suitesatubc.com/) is available\.

## Life Sciences Centre check\-in map

Thunderbird Parkade and Life Sciences Centre check\-in location\.

[Embedded iframe \(view source\)](https://www.google.com/maps/d/embed?mid=10yVmk6ARxZ_3jexPy5PJmBgle0R9dtU&ehbc=2E312F)

## Move In Day details

Detailed steps for arriving, checking in and moving into your room on Move In Day, which depend on how you get here\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)[Arriving by vehicle](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/#vehicle)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)[Arriving by taxi or rideshare](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/#taxi-rideshare)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)[Arriving by bus](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/#bus)

### Arriving by vehicle?

GPS is great for getting to UBC, but once you’re close to campus, follow our signs instead\. We’ve posted them at key points all over campus\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Park at the Thunderbird Parkade

Your first stop is the [Thunderbird Parkade](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MtCFCmsaKex5gWuB7), where you’ll park for free while you get checked in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)EV chargers are located on ground level\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Accessible parking stalls are located on ground level\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Parking in the Thunderbird Parkade is free on September1 and September 5, 8:30 am–11 pm\.

**Overheight vehicles:** vehicle clearance in the Thunderbird Parkade is 6’10” \(2\.08m\)\. If your vehicle is taller, park for free across the street in the [Osborne Lot](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2737.8%22N+123%C2%B014%2735.3%22W/@49.2605243,-123.2436182,147m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m13!1m8!3m7!1s0x548672b40e27b01d:0x97149712177d6d5a!2sParking+lot,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC+V6T+1Z2!3b1!8m2!3d49.266957!4d-123.2570269!16s%2Fg%2F11b8y6xgph!3m3!8m2!3d49.260498!4d-123.24313?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyMy4yIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) instead\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Proceed to the Life Sciences Centre

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Leave your belongings in your car\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Bring your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Exit the parkade via the [ground level pedestrian exit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TfxN2jpUXVUMTeWp9) \(NW corner by the EV chargers\) and follow the blue flags to the Life Sciences Centre\.

**Overheight vehicles:** leave your vehicle at the [Osborne Lot](https://www.google.com/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2737.8%22N+123%C2%B014%2735.3%22W/@49.2605243,-123.2436182,147m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m13!1m8!3m7!1s0x548672b40e27b01d:0x97149712177d6d5a!2sParking+lot,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC+V6T+1Z2!3b1!8m2!3d49.266957!4d-123.2570269!16s%2Fg%2F11b8y6xgph!3m3!8m2!3d49.260498!4d-123.24313?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyMy4yIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), cross Thunderbird Boulevard, and [take the path to the left of the parkade to the Life Sciences Centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r3WthFnjdkAwGNrHA)\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Check in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Follow the signs to enter the West Atrium of the Life Sciences Centre\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package and vehicle pass\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Get directions to your residence\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Proceed to your residence

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Return to your vehicle and drive your belongings to your residence building\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Follow our directions—and the signs located along your route—to get there\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Move in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Once you arrive at your residence, you’ll have 15 minutes to unload your vehicle and move your belongings to your new room\.  
    
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Moving carts are available to use for free—although a limited supply is available\. To borrow one, you need to leave us with your government\-issued photo ID\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Re\-park your vehicle at Thunderbird Parkade

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Once you’ve moved your stuff to your room, return to your vehicle\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Drive back to the Thunderbird Parkade and park for the remainder of the day—for free until 11 pm\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Unpack and settle in

🚀 Mission accomplished\!

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Return to your room\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Unpack\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Visit your commonsblock to check out the UBC Bookstore pop\-up store and pick up any extra supplies you need\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Settle in and make yourself at home\!

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Attend your first meeting and dinner at the dining hall

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Attend your first floor meeting with either your Jump Start orientation leader \(Sept\. 1\) or your Residence Advisor \(Sept\. 5\)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Your orientation leader or RA will let you know what time your floor is going to the dining hall for your first dinner—[Open Kitchen](https://food.ubc.ca/places/open-kitchen/) for Orchard Commons and Ritsumeikan\-UBC House residents; [Feast](https://food.ubc.ca/places/feast/) for Totem Park residents\.

### Arriving by taxi or rideshare?

If you’re arriving by taxi or rideshare \(i\.e\., Uber\), follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Your driver can drop you off at [6130 Agronomy Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DBcxHwDFomp38EXf9), directly across from the [Life Sciences Centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TwvgdZ986uEP2csb9)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Follow the signs to enter the West Atrium of the Life Sciences Centre\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Walk/roll or take our free shuttle to your residence\.

### Arriving by bus?

If you’re arriving by bus, follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)You’ll arrive at the [UBC Bus Exchange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nqyUrMEU7tsFmZj98) or [trolley bus loop](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+Exchange+@+Bay+10/@49.2658226,-123.2483204,73m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m15!1m8!3m7!1s0x548672b787aa42fd:0x38e3cff4a7d52c2d!2sUBC+Bus+Loop,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC!3b1!8m2!3d49.2678531!4d-123.2477071!16s%2Fg%2F11h7fm177r!3m5!1s0x548672b7cea304d7:0x55ecff169b7e418d!8m2!3d49.26581!4d-123.248129!16s%2Fg%2F11h03z79x?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYxNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), depending on which bus you take\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Proceed to the [Life Sciences Centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TwvgdZ986uEP2csb9): [walk/roll across campus](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/49.2669114,-123.2484316/UBC+Bookstore,+University+Boulevard,+Vancouver,+BC/49.2614328,-123.2470905/UBC+Life+Sciences+Centre+%28LSC%29+West+Atrium,+Health+Sciences+Mall,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2641361,-123.2527875,1174m/data=!3m3!1e3!4b1!5s0x548672c9046ff537:0x2a224d3de31f9b80!4m16!4m15!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x548672b63e443e4d:0xe3251289feb9b9f7!2m2!1d-123.2504201!2d49.2651875!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x54867340989074c1:0xf387b9f9ce6ecc35!2m2!1d-123.2450666!2d49.2624183!3e2?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wKgBIAVAD&skid=2769a0dd-232a-4b3b-b396-9f1a36f691ef) or [take transit from the UBC Bus Exchange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g8hUDvmwonGaQahS6)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Follow the signs to enter the West Atrium of the Life Sciences Centre\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)Walk/roll or take our free shuttle to your residence\.

## FAQs

### Do I need to book a timeslot?

If you’re planning to arrive on one of the two official Move In Days, during the time when our central check\-ins are open, you need to book a timeslot\. Watch for an email from us in August with info about how to book yours\!

### What if I miss my timeslot?

We understand that travel delays can occur\. If you end up arriving later than the move\-in timeslot you booked, but while our central check\-ins are still open, follow the same arrival and check\-in instructions and head to your central check\-in location as planned\.

### What if I arrive late?

You’ll be able to check in at your residence commonsblock starting about 90 minutes after the Flag Pole Plaza check\-in closes: 3 pm closure on Sept\. 1; 2 pm closure on Sept\. 5\.

Please arrive no later than 10:30 pm to check in at your residence commonsblock, to allow time for check\-in before the residence front desk closes at 11 pm sharp\.

If you’re arriving later than 10:30 pm, you’ll need to book a hotel and check\-in the next day \(7:30 am–10:30 pm\)\. On\-campus [hotel accommodation](https://suitesatubc.com/) is available\.

#### Where can I park if I arrive late?

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Orchard Commons and Ritsumeikan\-UBC House:** park at the [B4 Parking Lot,](https://www.google.ca/maps/place/49%C2%B015%2735.9%22N+123%C2%B014%2759.2%22W/@49.259957,-123.2508743,18z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x0:0x0!7e2!8m2!3d49.2599573!4d-123.2497801?shorturl=1) across Agronomy Road from Orchard Commons—then proceed to the [Orchard Commons Front Desk](https://www.google.ca/maps/place/Orchard+Commons+Student+Residence/@49.259978,-123.2513616,18z/data=!3m1!5s0x548672cba66be13b:0x9dbe9eeaafa252c!4m12!1m5!3m4!2zNDnCsDE1JzM1LjkiTiAxMjPCsDE0JzU5LjIiVw!8m2!3d49.2599722!4d-123.2497778!3m5!1s0x548672cbbf4a72d3:0x4819d6fcb81765d7!8m2!3d49.2600602!4d-123.2509365!16s%2Fg%2F11cnc63_m0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) to check in\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)**Totem Park:** park near the [Totem Park Commonsblock](https://www.google.ca/maps/place/Totem+Park+Student+Residence+-+Coquihalla+Commonsblock/@49.25818,-123.2525792,18z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672cb257176fd:0x125dd8a7e9a1ca46!8m2!3d49.2580101!4d-123.25297!16s%2Fg%2F1th0mlg5?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\. Please follow all posted parking regulations in the area\. Then proceed to the [Totem Park Front Desk](https://www.google.ca/maps/place/Totem+Park+Student+Residence+-+Coquihalla+Commonsblock/@49.2581167,-123.2526949,19z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672cb257176fd:0x125dd8a7e9a1ca46!8m2!3d49.2580101!4d-123.25297!16s%2Fg%2F1th0mlg5?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) to check in\.

### Can I arrive after Move In Day?

Yes, you can arrive on a later date\. Simply check in at your residence front desk, 7:30 am–10:30 pm \(a half hour after opening and a half hour before closing\) seven days a week\.

If you are using a vehicle and moving in on a date other than our two official Move In Days, you can park temporarily in a loading zone near your building while you briefly unload or park/pay at the [nearest parking lot or parkade](https://parking.ubc.ca/)\.

### Can I bring my pet?

While we love animals, pets are not permitted in residence\. Please leave your pet at home\.

### What if I forget to bring something?

UBC Bookstore also has plenty of [residence supplies](https://the.bookstore.ubc.ca/home--lifestyle/categories/residence-supplies) in stock, for purchase online or in\-store\.

## Questions?

Check out the complete [Move In Day guide](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)\. If you have additional questions that aren’t answered there, please email [move\.in\.day@ubc\.ca](mailto:move.in.day@ubc.ca)\.

[A grey, single\-storey building in an open plaza with green deciduous and coniforous trees and a cloudy sky in the background\.](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/acadia-park-commonsblock-1024x576.jpg)

Here’s a brief overview of how the day will go\. More details below\!

If you drove a vehicle, you’ll return to your vehicle and, if needed, drive closer to your unit\.

## Move In Day details

Detailed steps for arriving, checking in and moving into your room on Move In Day, which depend on how you get here\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)[Arriving by vehicle](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/#vehicle)

### Arriving by vehicle?

GPS is great for getting to UBC, but once you’re close to campus, follow our signs instead\. We’ve posted them at key points all over campus\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Park at the Fairview Avenue parking lot

Your first stop is the [Fairview Avenue parking lot](https://www.google.com/maps/place//@49.2625078,-123.2402511,147m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m6!1m5!3m4!2zNDnCsDE1JzQ1LjMiTiAxMjPCsDE0JzIzLjkiVw!8m2!3d49.2625833!4d-123.2399722?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDcwNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), where you’ll park for free while you get checked in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Parking in the Fairview Avenue parking lot is free on Sept\. 5, 8:30 am–4 pm\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Proceed to the Acadia Park Commonsblock

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Leave your belongings in your car\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Bring your government\-issued photo ID\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Check in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Come on in to the Acadia Park Commonsblock\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Visit the front desk\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package and vehicle pass \(Term One Move In only\)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Get directions to your unit at Fairview Crescent\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Proceed to your residence

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Return to your vehicle and, if needed, drive your belongings closer to your unit at Fairview Crescent\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Follow our directions—and the signs located along your route—to get there\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Move in

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)If you drive to a temporary spot closer to your unit, you’ll have 15 minutes to unload your vehicle and move your belongings to your new unit\.  
    
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Moving carts are available to use for free—although a limited supply is available\. To borrow one, you need to leave us with your government\-issued photo ID\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Re\-park your vehicle

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Whether you drove closer to your unit or not, once you’ve moved your stuff to your room, return to your vehicle\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Drive to a nearby lot and pay to park for the remainder of your day\.

Learn more about [residence parking permits](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/services-amenities/parking/)\.

#### [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Unpack and settle in

🚀 Mission accomplished\!

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Return to your room\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Unpack\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Visit the [UBC Bookstore](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+Bookstore/@49.2652012,-123.252959,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672b63e443e4d:0xe3251289feb9b9f7!8m2!3d49.2652012!4d-123.2503841!16s%2Fg%2F1q63ckxxf?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) pick up any extra [residence supplies](https://the.bookstore.ubc.ca/home--lifestyle/categories/residence-supplies) you need\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Settle in and make yourself at home\!

### Arriving by taxi or rideshare?

If you’re arriving by taxi or rideshare \(i\.e\., Uber\), follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Your driver can drop you off at the [Acadia Park Commonsblock](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Acadia+Park+Commonsblock/@49.262732,-123.2399779,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672c60aef6be1:0x8d5347ce8d851cb2!8m2!3d49.262732!4d-123.237403!16s%2Fg%2F1tgtf5lz?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Visit the front desk\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Walk/roll to Fairview Crescent\.

### Arriving by bus?

If you’re arriving by bus, follow these directions to arrive, check in and move in\.

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)You’ll arrive at the [UBC Bus Exchange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nqyUrMEU7tsFmZj98) or [trolley bus loop](https://www.google.com/maps/place/UBC+Exchange+@+Bay+10/@49.2658226,-123.2483204,73m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m15!1m8!3m7!1s0x548672b787aa42fd:0x38e3cff4a7d52c2d!2sUBC+Bus+Loop,+University+Endowment+Lands,+BC!3b1!8m2!3d49.2678531!4d-123.2477071!16s%2Fg%2F11h7fm177r!3m5!1s0x548672b7cea304d7:0x55ecff169b7e418d!8m2!3d49.26581!4d-123.248129!16s%2Fg%2F11h03z79x?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYxNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D), depending on which bus you take\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Proceed to the [Acadia Park Commonsblock](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Acadia+Park+Commonsblock/@49.262732,-123.2399779,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x548672c60aef6be1:0x8d5347ce8d851cb2!8m2!3d49.262732!4d-123.237403!16s%2Fg%2F1tgtf5lz?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D): [walk/roll across campus](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/49.2672642,-123.248842/Acadia+Park+Commonsblock,+Commonsblock,+Tennis+Crescent,+Vancouver,+BC/@49.2652006,-123.2474805,1174m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m9!4m8!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x548672c60aef6be1:0x8d5347ce8d851cb2!2m2!1d-123.237403!2d49.262732!3e2?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDYyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) or [take transit from the UBC Bus Exchange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/F2kxm16co5Tfy8E87)\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Come on in to the Acadia Park Commonsblock\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Visit the front desk\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Present your government\-issued photo ID\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Pick up your check\-in package\.
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/fairview-crescent-check-in/)Walk/roll to Fairview Crescent\.

## FAQs

### Do I need to book a timeslot?

Residents moving in on May 10, 2026 do not need to select a timeslot\. You can go directly to your residence front desk to check\-in\.

If you’re planning to arrive on our official Move In Day \(Sept\. 5, 2026\), you need to book a timeslot\. Watch for an email from us in August with info about how to book yours\!

### What if I miss my timeslot?

We understand that travel delays can occur\. If you end up arriving later than the move\-in timeslot you booked, but before 10:30 pm, follow the same arrival and check\-in instructions: park and check\-in as planned\.

### What if I arrive late?

If you’ll be arriving too late to check in on Move In Day, you’ll need to book a hotel and check\-in at the Acadia Park Commonsblock the next day \(7:30 am–10:30 pm\)\. On\-campus [hotel accommodation](https://suitesatubc.com/) is available\.

### Can I arrive after Move In Day?

Yes, you can arrive on a later date\. Simply check in at the Acadia Park Commonsblock, 7:30 am–10:30 pm \(a half hour after opening and a half hour before closing\) seven days a week\.

If you are using a vehicle and moving in on a date other than our two official Move In Days, you can park temporarily in a loading zone near your building while you briefly unload or park/pay at the [nearest parking lot or parkade](https://parking.ubc.ca/)\.

### Can I bring my pet?

While we love animals, pets are not permitted in residence\. Please leave your pet at home\.

### What if I forget to bring something?

UBC Bookstore also has plenty of [residence supplies](https://the.bookstore.ubc.ca/home--lifestyle/categories/residence-supplies) in stock, for purchase online or in\-store\.

## Questions?

Check out the complete [Move In Day guide](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)\. If you have additional questions that aren’t answered there, please email [move\.in\.day@ubc\.ca](mailto:move.in.day@ubc.ca)\.

[Move In Day](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/move-in-day-1024x576.jpg)

**Move In Day at UBC Vancouver is an exciting time, with thousands of students moving into residence for the first time—and many students returning to campus\.**

Find out everything you need to know to make your move in experience smooth and successful\.

## On this page

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[Residence Move In](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#move-in)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[Move In dates](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#dates)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[Who moves in on these dates?](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#residences)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[How do I get to UBC and check in?](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#arrive-check-in)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[Move In Day Webinar](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#webinar)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[Additional Move In Days](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#additional)
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)[FAQs](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/#faqs)

## Residence Move In

### Winter Session: Term 1

There are two official Winter Session Move In Days at UBC Vancouver, which occur annually in late August and/or early September\.

[Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)

### Move In Day: Sept\. 1

**For students attending Jump Start**  
**Tuesday, Sept\. 1, 2026**  
**9 am–3 pm**

[Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)

### Move In Day: Sept\. 5

**For all other Winter Session students**  
**Saturday, Sept\. 5, 2026**  
**9 am–2 pm**

## Who moves in on these dates?

Students with Winter Session \(September–April\) contracts in the following residences\.

### Residences

-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Fairview Crescent
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Ponderosa Commons
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Totem Park
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Orchard Commons
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Ritsumeikan\-UBC House
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Walter Gage
-   [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Place Vanier

Some students with year round contracts in other residence areas may also move in on these dates\.

## How do I get to UBC and check in?

**Find your residence and check\-in location below** to get all the information about when to arrive, how to get here, and how to check in and move in to your new room/unit\.

Plus, get the answers to FAQs, such as “What if I arrive late?” or “What if I forgot to bring something?” and more\.

### Arrival and check\-in information

If you’re moving in on one of our two official Move In Days, you’ll most likely check in at one of two central check\-in locations—[Flag Pole Plaza](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/flag-pole-plaza-check-in/) or the [Life Sciences Centre](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/life-sciences-check-in/)—before proceeding to your residence\.

## [Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)Don’t miss our move\-in emails\!

Watch for emails about a week before your Move In Day with info about getting here, checking in and moving in\.

We’ll email you at the email address listed in your profile on the SHCS [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/), so please double check to make sure it’s correct and up\-to\-date\.

## Additional Move In Days

In addition to these Move In Days, there are also official Move In Days for students moving in to residence in January and May\.

Learn more about our [additional Move In Days](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/additional-move-in-days/)\.

## FAQs

### Can I move in before my Move In Day?

We are typically not able to permit move\-ins prior to your move in day \(i\.e\., Jump Start Move In Day or Labour Day Move In Day, as applicable\)\. If you are planning to arrive in Vancouver early, be sure to plan where you’ll be staying prior to your move in day\. Staying with friends and family or in a [short\-term accommodation](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/other-housing/off-campus-housing/#short-term-accommodation) are good options\.

### **What if i’m moving in after Sept\. 5**?

If you’re arriving after the official Move In Day of Sept\. 5, please proceed directly to your residence front desk to check\-in\. The front desk is open between 7:00 am to 11:00 pm daily\. Please arrive by 10:30 pm at the latest to check\-in before the front desks close at 11 pm\.

### Can a friend or family member check in for me?

No\. Your ID is used during check\-in and is used to confirm if you are the correct person so you can sign your resident card and get your keys\.

[Your belongings can be moved in/out if the official resident authorizes it](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/designated-movers/), but the family/friend will be escorted by a member of our front desk team– no keys are handed over\.

### Can I ship packages to residence before Move In Day?

No, please don’t ship anything to residence ahead of your move in\.

[Musqueam Post—ʔi:ɬqəy̓ \(double\-headed serpent\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/musqueam-post-1024x576.jpg)

In addition to our primary [Move In Days](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/) in late August / early September, we host official Move In Days for students moving in at the beginning of January and May\.

Find out everything you need to know to make your move in experience smooth and successful\.

## May Move In

There are two official Move In Days annually each May—one for students moving into Year Round residence and one for students moving into Summer residence\.

If you’re moving into Acadia Park, visit [Moving in and out of Acadia Park](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residence-life/acadia-park-resources/moving-acadia-park/)\.

## How do I get to UBC and check in?

If you’re moving in on this date, check [Arrive at your residence front desk](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/front-desk-check-in/) and watch for an email from us in April\.

**Traffic alert: Several road closures are in place on Move\-in Day, due to various construction projects\. Specifically, University Boulevard is closed between Marine Drive and Lower Mall\. Check [road closure](https://bmovanmarathon.ca/detours) info and plan your route accordingly\.**

*Note: we’ll email you at the email address listed in your profile on the SHCS [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/), so please double check to make sure it’s correct and up\-to\-date\.*

## January Move In

Students starting a new Winter Session or Year Round residence contract in January move in at the beginning of Winter Session Term 2\.

[Embedded svg \(view source\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/additional-move-in-days/)

### Move In Day: Jan\. 4, 2026

**Sunday, January 4, 2026**  
**1 pm–10:30 pm**  
**Check in at your residence front desk**

## Who moves in on this date?

Students with a January contract start date who are moving into any of our residence areas—Winter Session, Year Round or Student Family residence—might move in on this date\.

## How do I get to UBC and check in?

If you’re moving in on this date, watch for an email from us in late December with detailed Move In Day information and view the [arrival instructions for your residence](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/front-desk-check-in/)\.

*Note: we’ll email you at the email address listed in your profile on the SHCS [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/), so please double check to make sure it’s correct and up\-to\-date\.*

If you do not receive an email by January 2, please email [move\.in\.day@ubc\.ca](mailto:move.in.day@ubc.ca)\.

Be aware that the Student Housing Main Office is typically closed between December 22 and January 3 \(inclusive\)\. The Winter Break schedule is posted on our [contact us](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/) page prior to the break\.

## FAQS

**What if I’m arriving after my official Move\-in date \(May 3, May 10 or June 7\)?**  
Your unit is yours and will remain empty until you move in\. If you’re arriving after any of the above listed dates, you will check in at your residence front desk between 7 am and 10:45 pm on the date that you arrive\.  
  
  
**Can a friend or family member check in for me?**  
No\. Your ID is used during check\-in and is used to confirm if you are the correct person so you can sign your resident card and get your keys\.  
   
[Your belongings can be moved in/out if the official resident authorizes it](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/designated-movers/), but the family/friend will be escorted by a member of our front desk team – no keys are handed over\.

**What if I’m arriving after January 4?**  
That’s not a problem\. From January 5 onwards, you can check in at your residence front desk between 7 am and 10:45 pm\. As a reminder, Term 2 classes start on Monday, January 5\.   
  
**What if I’m arriving before January 4?**  
If you haven’t requested an early arrival, you will need to find alternate accommodation\.

## FAQs

### Do I need to book a timeslot?

No, you do not need to reserve an arrival time\.

### **What if I’m** arriving **after my official move\-in date \(May 3, May 10 or June 7, 2026\)**?

Your unit is yours and will remain empty until you move in\. If you’re arriving after any of the above listed dates, you will check in at your residence front desk between 7 am and 10:45 pm on the date that you arrive\.

### Can a friend or family member check in for me?

No\. Your ID is used during check\-in and is used to confirm if you are the correct person so you can sign your resident card and get your keys\.

[Your belongings can be moved in/out if the official resident authorizes it](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/designated-movers/), but the family/friend will be escorted by a member of our front desk team – no keys are handed over\.

### **What if i’m moving in after January 4, 2026?**

If you’re arriving after the official Move In Day of January 4, please proceed directly to your residence front desk to check\-in\. The front desk is open between 7:00 am to 11:00 pm daily\. Please arrive by 10:30 pm at the latest to check\-in before the front desks close at 11 pm\.  

### What if I arrive late?

If you’ll be arriving too late to check in and move in, you’ll need to book a hotel and check\-in at your residence front desk the next day\. On\-campus [hotel accommodation](https://suitesatubc.com/) is available\.

### Can I bring my pet?

While we love animals, pets are not permitted in residence\. Please leave your pet at home\.

### What if I forget to bring something?

UBC Bookstore also has plenty of [residence supplies](https://the.bookstore.ubc.ca/home--lifestyle/categories/residence-supplies) in stock, for purchase online or in\-store\.

## Questions?

Check out the complete [Move In Day guide](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)\. If you have additional questions that aren’t answered there, please email [move\.in\.day@ubc\.ca](mailto:move.in.day@ubc.ca)\.

title: Designated Movers
content_markdown:
**If you’ve been assigned a unit in residence, but can’t be there to move in your belongings, follow the instructions below to designate another person to move your belongings in for you\.**

### How to request approval

-   Print and complete \(or electronically complete\) the [Designated Move\-in/Move\-out Form](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Designated-Move-In-Move-Out-Request-Form_UBC-Student-Housing_Jan-2021.pdf)\.
-   Submit this form in\-person \(to your residence front desk\) or by email \(addresses included on the form\)\.
-   Include 1 copy of your government issued photo ID \(e\.g\., driver’s licence or passport\)\.
-   **Deadline to submit:** two business days before the move/access date\.

**Approval:** Front Desk Supervisors or Residence Life Managers can provide approvals\. Requests made via email will be confirmed via email\.

[DOWNLOAD THE FORM](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Designated-Move-In-Move-Out-Request-Form_UBC-Student-Housing_Dec-2025_01.pdf)

### Designated Move In Date Information

#### When can your move occur?

-   Weekdays: 10 am–8 pm
-   Weekends/holidays: 10 am–6 pm \(except for Thunderbird, which is weekdays only\)

*Moves must occur on a single date\. Multi\-day moves are not permitted\.*

#### What does your designated person need to bring?

Government\-issued Photo ID, which matches the information provided above\. Staff will hold their ID at the front desk while the move is in\-progress\.

#### Will your designated person be given room keys?

No\. Staff will escort your designated person to the unit and they will not be given keys\.

#### What happens when the move is finished?

Your designated person must return to the front desk to pick up their photo ID and let staff know the move is complete, so that they can secure the room\.

### Questions?

Please contact your [residence front desk](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/)\.

title: Additional eligibility: Student Family Residence
content_markdown:
In addition to the [primary eligibility criteria](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/), to be eligible to live in Student Family Residence:

-   One adult resident must be a full\-time student who meets the academic credit load requirements and maintain good standing with UBC\.
-   The family must maintain good standing with Student Housing\.

## Additional eligibility requirements

All units at Acadia Park\.

### Household composition

Student Family Residence at Acadia Park is reserved exclusively for student families:

1.  One or more adults with one or more dependent children \(18 years of age or younger\)
2.  More than one adult in a long\-term relationship\.

Learn more below about what [size of unit](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/student-family-residence/#unit-size) you are eligible to live in\.

### Age

-   **Age requirement \(adults\):** 19 years or older\.
-   **Age requirement \(children\):** 18 years or younger\.

### Primary residence of child\(ren\)

At least one child must reside in Acadia Park for a minimum of ten months per year\.

Additional documentation

When you apply for Student Family Residence, you must send additional documentation for all intended occupants\.

[Learn more](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/how-to-apply/ive-applied-now-what/#additional-documentation)

## What unit size/type am I eligible to live in?

Acadia Park features one, two, three and four bedroom units\.

You are eligible to live in a unit that is an appropriate fit for your family size and composition, aligned with Canadian [National Occupancy Standards](https://www.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/professionals/industry-innovation-and-leadership/industry-expertise/affordable-housing/provincial-territorial-agreements/investment-in-affordable-housing/national-occupancy-standard)\.

Please refer to the table below for information about which unit size your family is eligible for\.

If you have any questions about your eligibility for a unit size, or if you would like to request a unit size that does not align with the eligibility requirements outlined, please email us at [family@housing\.ubc\.ca](mailto:family@housing.ubc.ca)\.

### Waitlists/offers

Once your application is accepted, you will be placed on a waitlist for the unit sizes you are eligible for, and you will receive an offer once you reach the top of the waitlist for any of your eligible unit sizes\.

For example, if you have one child, you might receive an offer for a one bedroom, one bedroom \+ den, or a two bedroom unit, depending on which unit size you reach the top of the waitlist for first\.

### Unit size and eligibility

| Adults | Children | One Bedroom | One Bedroom \+ Den | Two Bedroom | Three Bedroom | Four Bedroom |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Two | None | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible\* | Ineligible | Ineligible |
| Max\. two | One | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Ineligible | Ineligible |
| Max\. two | Two | Ineligible | Ineligible | Eligible | Eligible | Ineligible |
| Max\. two | Three | Ineligible | Ineligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible |
| Max\. two | More than three | Ineligible | Ineligible | Ineligible | Eligible | Eligible |

\*Couples without children may indicate their interest in receiving an offer for a two\-bedroom unit; however, priority will be given to families with children\.

title: Additional eligibility: Summer Residence
content_markdown:
In addition to the [primary eligibility criteria](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/), to be eligible to live in Summer Residence you must be a full\-time student who meets the academic credit load requirements \(with limited exceptions, outlined below\) and maintain good standing with UBC and Student Housing\.

## Residences and room types

-   **Residences:** Fairview Crescent\.
-   **Room types:** One bedroom or a single room in a shared four or six bedroom unit\.

## Age requirement

**Minimum age requirement:** 19 years old

## Academic credit load requirements

At basic, students offered a contract in Summer Residence must be registered in sufficient coursework at UBC Vancouver during either the same Summer Session or in Term 2 of the preceding Winter Session\.

### Registration in Summer Session

You are registered in sufficient coursework during the Summer Session—either 6 credits of undergraduate coursework or a full\-time graduate program\.

### Registration in preceding Winter Session

You were registered full\-time during Term 2 of the preceding Winter Session at UBC Vancouver \(i\.e\., January to April\)\.

You may have lived in either Winter Session or Year Round Residence, but you are not required to have lived in residence on\-campus\.

First consideration for offers

Please note that first consideration for Summer Residence offers will be given to UBC students who are registered in Summer Session or who were registered in the preceding Winter Session\.

Other eligible students will be assigned based on availability\.

### Other eligible students

There are two types of students who do not need to meet the academic credit load requirements:

#### UBC students employed by UBC in a research capacity

If you are a UBC student employed during the Summer Session by a UBC department in a research capacity, you are not required to meet the academic credit load requirement\.

**Additional documentation:** you must provide proof of employment, such as a copy of your appointment notice\.

#### Students from another university performing UBC\-directed research

If you are full\-time student from another university who is performing research directed by a UBC department, you are not required to meet the academic credit load requirement\.

**Additional documentation:** you must provide proof of UBC sponsorship or employment and proof of your student status, including your student number, at your home university\.

title: Eligibility: Arriving early
content_markdown:
Typically, students are not eligible to move in prior to their scheduled contract start date\.

If you are planning to arrive in Vancouver early, you’ll need to plan where you’ll be staying prior to your move in day\. Staying with friends and family or in a [short\-term accommodation](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/other-housing/off-campus-housing/#short-term-accommodation) are good options\.

Students moving into Winter Session residence, who are participating in select early\-starting UBC programs may inquire about the possibility of an earlier arrival date\.

**First year students participating in Jump Start**–you do not need to apply to arrive early; you are automatically scheduled to move in on [Jump Start Move In Day](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/move-in-day/)\.

Please note that [fees apply](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/fees-payments/early-arrival/) for approved early arrivals\.

## Eligible groups

The following groups may apply to be considered for an early arrival\. Please note, that eligibility does not guarantee an early arrival request will be approved\.

-   **Students in early\-starting academic programs**—you need to [apply for early arrival](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/how-to-apply/application-forms/#early-arrival)\.
-   **Varsity athletes participating in early\-starting team practices** \(officially approved by UBC Athletics and Recreation\)—you need to [apply for early arrival](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/how-to-apply/application-forms/#early-arrival)\.
-   **Indigenous students of Canada attending a welcome/orientation event hosted by the [First Nations House of Learning](https://fnhl.ubc.ca/)**—you need to [apply for early arrival](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/how-to-apply/application-forms/#early-arrival)\.

## Additional eligibility requirements

-   You will be living in a [Winter Session residence](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/residences/#winter-session)\.\*
-   You submitted your Winter Session residence application by the [applicable deadline](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\.
-   You submitted all required [residence and meal plan payment\(s\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/fees-payments/) prior to the [applicable deadline\(s\)](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\.
-   You apply to arrive early by the [applicable deadline](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\.

\*Residents moving into Year Round residence are not eligible to move in early\. Please make [alternative arrangements](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/other-housing/off-campus-housing/#short-term-accommodation) if you will be arriving in Vancouver prior to your scheduled move\-in date\.

title: Lower Mall Precinct Project Construction
content_markdown:
[Image](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/lower-mall-precinct-project-renderings-september-2025-12-e1764111448178.jpg)

*Architectural rendering of Lower Mall Precinct buildings \(intersection of University Boulevard and Lower Mall\)\. From left to right: buildings 2, 1 and 6\.*

The [Lower Mall Precinct \(LMP\) project](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/residences-rooms/projects/lower-mall-precinct/) will address the growing demand for student housing by building more than 1,500 graduate student focused beds \(1,325 new and 175 replacement\)\.

This new residence will also support the wider campus community through the incorporation of a child care and dining hall for the UBC community, plus numerous amenities and social spaces for residents\.

It will also serve as the new home for St\. John’s College \(SJC\) Fellows and will breathe new life into UBC’s [Old Fire Hall](https://news.ubc.ca/2024/11/ubc-historic-fire-hall-moves/), which will be relocated to the site and renovated as a hub for residents\.

## Applying to live nearby?

If you’re planning to add Marine Drive or Ponderosa Commons to your preferences in your residence application—or you’re applying for first year residence—we want you to make an informed decision when you apply\.

Please be aware that some residents at Marine Drive, Ponderosa Commons and Place Vanier, whose rooms/units are located closest to the LMP site, will experience some impacts from construction activity and noise associated with this construction project\.

  

## Project Details

### Location

[Embedded iframe \(view source\)](https://www.google.com/maps/d/embed?mid=1msW0LgEyN0OHAiljCdjcBCGQ5NQ4OqM&ehbc=2E312F&noprof=1)

The project site is located between University Boulevard, Lower Mall, SW Marine Drive and the Marine Drive residence area\.

### Project timeline: 2026 to 2029

**January 2026: Site servicing, roadwork and underground infrastructure upgrades begins\.** 

**Mid\-May 2026: St\. John’s College decommissioning begins**, including the setup of on\-site construction offices\.

**August 2026: Construction begins\.**

**2028: Phase 1 buildings open\. 🎉** Buildings 4, 5 and 6, which include studio and shared units \(with kitchens\), a sky lounge—a top floor student lounge/study space—and the child care facility\.

**2029: Phase 2 buildings open\. 🎉** Buildings 1, 2 and 3, along with the relocation/renovation of the [Old Fire Hall](https://news.ubc.ca/2024/11/ubc-historic-fire-hall-moves/)\. These buildings include a sky lounge—a top floor student lounge/study space—the dining hall, SJC spaces, and studio and shared units \(with kitchens\)\. There will also be 400 single rooms \(with private bath, without kitchens\), a new unit type which will house students on a required meal plan\.

Ongoing road closure: University Boulevard between NW Marine Drive and Lower Mall

Starting in spring 2026, University Boulevard—between NW Marine Drive and Lower Mall—will be closed to traffic for the duration of the project\. The sidewalk on the north side of University Boulevard \(i\.e\. closest to Place Vanier\) will remain accessible to pedestrians\. Learn more about [road closures](https://planning.ubc.ca/roadwork) on campus\.

### Ongoing/daily schedule

**Construction typically occurs during UBC’s standard approved hours of work: Monday–Friday, 7:30 am–7 pm, and Saturday, 9 am–5 pm\.**

**Some workers will arrive on\-site before the construction start time to begin getting ready for their day\.**

Construction hours may be extended \(e\.g\., earlier start time; extended to Sundays\) to ensure the project is completed on time\.

## Noise and disruptions for nearby residents

As you are likely aware, construction at UBC is an everyday activity, and safe, prudent construction practices are followed\. Nevertheless, while UBC can reduce the impact to residents and the campus community, it cannot be avoided altogether\.

Residents of Marine Drive, Ponderosa Commons and some residents at Place Vanier should expect to hear noise from heavy equipment, industrial traffic and construction\. There will also be pedestrian and vehicle traffic disruptions in the area, along with an increased level of dust\.

Residents who are closest to and face directly toward the project site will be most affected, while those who are further away and/or do not face the project site will be less affected\.

For example:

-   Residents in Marine Drive Building 6 who face south, may not experience much impact from the project\.
-   Residents in Ponderosa Commons \(Cedar House\) who face north may not experience much impact from the project\.
-   Place Vanier residents who are assigned to a building north of the commonsblock may not experience any impact from the project at their residence building\.

## Questions?

**Are you offering a discount?**

No\. Construction at UBC is an everyday occurrence that we should all be prepared for—and that the UBC community will ultimately benefit from\.

**What if I don't want to live near a construction site?**

If you do not want to live near the Lower Mall Precinct Project construction site, we recommend the following:

-   **Current Marine Drive, Ponderosa Commons or Place Vanier residents:** you are welcome to apply for a room switch or transfer\.
-   **If you are on the housing waitlist and indicated Marine Drive or Ponderosa Commons as preferences:** we recommend that you remove these residences from your list of preferences\.
-   **Year Round Residence applicants:** we recommend that you do not indicate Marine Drive or Ponderosa Commons as a preference in your application\.
-   **First Year Winter Session applicants:** eligible first year applicants receive assignments for either Orchard Commons, Place Vanier, Ritsumeikan\-UBC House, Totem Park or Walter Gage and cannot opt out of living at Place Vanier specifically\. However, the majority of rooms/buildings at Place Vanier will only experience very limited impacts from this construction project\. Once you receive your assignment in early to mid\-August, if you are assigned to a building nearest to the construction project, you are welcome to find another resident to [switch rooms](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/switch/) with\.

**How noisy will *my* room be?**

While construction noise will be kept within reasonable limits, every person responds to noise and disruption differently\. With that in mind, we cannot anticipate how noisy your particular room will be or how the construction noise will affect you\.

**Where can I get earplugs?**

If desired, you can pick up free earplugs from your residence front desk\.

**Will any units not be affected?**

Any resident of Marine Drive, Ponderosa Commons or Place Vanier might experience some noise disruptions in their room/unit, another part of their residence area or while in the vicinity of the project\. However, as noted above, rooms/units that are at the greatest distance from the project and/or face away from the project will experience the lowest impacts\.

**How can residents stay informed about the project, including updates and timelines?**

Residents can check this web page for any updates, progress and timelines\. In addition to this page, Student Housing will be sending periodic email updates/notices at key project milestones or updates—or ahead of work that will cause more significant disturbances\.

**What if I move into Marine Drive, Ponderosa Commons or Place Vanier and the disruptions are worse than I expected?**

If you move into one of these residences, but you find the impact to be greater than you anticipated, you might consider applying for a [room switch or transfer](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/moving-in/switch/)\.

### Additional questions?

If you have additional questions, please email [lmpproject@housing\.ubc\.ca](mailto:lmpproject@housing.ubc.ca)\.

### Abolaji Ajibola

***Being an RA has been a truly rewarding experience\. One that has taught me the value of community, compassion and connection\.***  

  

Read Abolaji's story

Hello everyone\! My name is Abolaji, and I’m an RA in Place Vanier\. I’m currently in my fourth year in the Faculty of Science, majoring in Biology with a minor in Environmental Science\. This is my third year as a Residence Advisor, and I still can’t believe how far I’ve come\. When I first applied to be an RA, I was so nervous and unsure of what to expect, but here I am now, three years later, feeling confident, proud, and so grateful for everything this role has taught me\.

My time as an RA has been transformative\. It’s helped me build my confidence, strengthen my leadership skills, and grow in ways that have impacted almost every part of my life\. It’s been incredibly rewarding to build meaningful and lasting connections with people, support residents, and create a welcoming environment where students feel seen and valued\.

Outside of Residence Life, I enjoy spending time in nature, reading, drawing, and exploring new creative outlets\. I’m so excited for another amazing year as an RA and I can’t wait to continue growing, learning, and supporting my residents along the way\!  

*Abolaji Ajibola \(she/her\)  
**Residence Advisor, Place Vanier*  
*Fourth year, majoring in Biology and minoring in Environmental Science\.*

### Anraj Soni

***Every day as an RA is unique; from fun events to late\-night chats, it’s all about building community together\!***  

Read Anraj's story

Hi there\! My name is Anraj and I’m a Residence Advisor at Totem Park\.

I still remember how my 17\-year old self felt during my first few days at UBC; moving 3,000 km\+ from Toronto to Vancouver was so daunting\.

My RA went above and beyond to foster community among residents\. From different events to multiple check\-ins to floor\-wide meals, I quickly felt at home in the UBC community\.

Seeing the impact an RA has, I decided to apply\! Since 2022, I’ve had the chance to serve as an RA across Orchard Commons and Totem Park\. It truly has been an incredible experience\. From supporting 90\+ residents to meeting lifelong friends to hosting events, my RA journey has been full of so many good memories and growth\!

Being an RA has also opened many doors for me in my professional career\. The communication and leadership skills I developed help me land internships at companies I only dreamed of, like Tesla, Rocket Lab, and Arc Boats across cities like San Francisco, Toronto, and Los Angeles\!

I owe a lot to my RA experience and encourage anyone interested to take the first leap and apply\! You never know where it might take you\! 🙂

  
*Anraj Soni \(he/him\)*  
*Residence Advisor, Totem Park*  
*Fourth Year, Mechanical Engineering*

### Ayomiposi Olayinka

***Working in Residence Life means growing alongside others through learning, leading, and creating spaces in which everyone can truly belong and thrive\.***  

Read Ayomiposi's story

Hey there\! My name is Ayomiposi, and I’m a fourth\-year Manufacturing Engineering student\.

Throughout my time at UBC, I’ve explored a range of experiences, from being on an engineering design team to leading the Africa Awareness Initiative and participating in the co\-op program\. Each has taught me something unique, but my time in Residence Life has been the most remarkable\.

As a Senior Residence Advisor, I’ve had the chance to build community, support residents through their university transitions, and create space for RAs to grow\. Having experienced the position from both the RA and Senior RA perspectives, I’ve come to appreciate how deeply it develops people skills, professional growth, and confidence, which all prepare you for life beyond university and the industry\. It teaches you to listen, adapt, and lead with empathy, while strengthening the problem\-solving and interpersonal skills that make you a better teammate and leader\. Whether it’s being an approachable first contact for residents and their families during move\-in day traffic shifts or providing day\-to\-day support, I value the trust that comes with this role\. The support from management also plays a big role, as they encourage reflection, independence, and the confidence to take on new opportunities for growth\.

  
*Ayomiposi Olayinka \(she/her\)*  
*Senior Residence Advisor, Orchard Commons*  
*Fourth Year, Manufacturing Engineering*

### Joanna Guan

***It’s easy to show up to work when being an RA is such a rewarding student leadership experience\!***  

Read Joanna's story

Hi everyone, I’m Joanna and I am a Resident Advisor in Totem Park\. I’m in my third year of my BCOM degree studying Finance\. This is my story from the beginning to now\.

I first arrived at university in tears, not quite sure what to expect of first year\. It wasn’t until I moved into my dorm did it start to feel real: the freedom, the responsibility, and the amazing people\. The first to make me feel at home in this new environment were the community of RAs and floormates\. I found a diverse selection of resources on campus that helped me smoothly transition, and attended many fun events\.

Being an RA is the most rewarding job ever\. I love working with my team of talented, passionate and hilarious superstars\. They have taught me how to develop healthy communication skills, balance a life of work and play and be a leader\. Additionally, I love building connections with residents\. It is the most rewarding part of the job to see them grow into their own personalities over the year and make connections with each other\.

Residence life does such an amazing job on providing students with opportunities to build robust, healthy communities\. Being able to contribute to this mission has defined my experience at UBC\.”

  
*Joanna Guan \(she/her & he/him\)*  
*Residence Advisor, Totem Park*  
*Third year, BCOM, Finance*

### Joey Dolayba

***As an RA, I’ve grown alongside my community\. There’s nothing more rewarding than learning to support residents, navigate challenges and build connections\.***  

Read Joey's story

  
Hi\! I’m Joey Dolayba, a Residence Advisor at Ritsumeikan\-UBC House\. I grew up on Vancouver Island, and I’m now in my fifth year at UBC, studying Political Science in the Faculty of Arts\.

In my first year, I never expected how much my time at UBC would be shaped by the communities I joined\. Beyond being an RA, I’ve been involved with Campus Tours, the Arts Undergraduate Society, and intramurals with UBC REC\. Each group has taught me something new, but the RA community has been the most constant\. Over the past three years in Ponderosa Commons, Orchard Commons, and now Ritsumeikan, I’ve felt supported, challenged, and inspired by other RAs and managers, and I’ve been lucky to work alongside residents who continue to motivate me every day\.

I wanted to become an RA because of the impact my own first\-year RA had on me\. I still remember moving in and finding a personalized welcome letter taped to my door\. It instantly made me feel at home\. Now, as an RA, I get to offer that same sense of community to my residents\. It’s a privilege to see them grow, step outside their comfort zones, and form meaningful connections\.

  
*Joey Dolayba \(he/him\)*  
*Residence Advisor, Ritsumeikan\-UBC House*  
*Fifth Year, Faculty of Arts, Political Science*

### Thomas McIlwraith

***I have grown personally and professionally while working with Residence Life\. I have developed skills and connections which will last a lifetime\.***  

Read Thomas's story

  
Hello\! I’m Thomas\! I’m a fourth year student from Ontario and a Senior Residence Advisor at Place Vanier\.

This is my third year working with Residence Life on Musqueam lands and it has been a rewarding and fulfilling journey\. I am thankful for the opportunity to work with colleagues from all around the world, many of whom I am proud to call my friends\. I have developed skills in leadership, communication, facilitation, support, and in many other areas\. I am most proud of the diverse programs I have designed to foster healthy connections between first year students, whether that be to promote active living, provide resources for success in university and beyond, or even create a thrilling musical theatre performance\!

Navigating the challenges of university life and living away from home has not been easy\. However, my Residence Life colleagues, supervisors, and friends have supported me through every step\. I am incredibly grateful for the connections I have developed and I am certain they will last a lifetime\.

Outside of Residence Life, I enjoy running, skiing, singing with UBC Choirs, and performing research on weather forecasts\. I hope to use the skills I have developed as a residence advisor to foster welcoming spaces at UBC and elsewhere\!  

  
*Thomas McIlwraith \(he/they\)*  
*Senior Residence Advisor, Place Vanier*

[Image](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/UBC_20210903_PJ_9493-1-1024x681-1.jpg)

**UBC’s Vancouver campus is located on the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm \(Musqueam\) people\. The Okanagan campus is located on the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Syilx Okanagan Nation\.**

**For generations, these lands have been a place of teaching and learning for Indigenous peoples—a tradition that continues to this day\.**

This guide is for Indigenous students who are applying to live in student residence at UBC\.

Whether you are a first\-year, upper\-year or graduate student, use this guide to better understand how the process works, how we can help and what to expect when you move into your new space\.

##

# Indigenous student housing access

As an Indigenous student, you are guaranteed a place in residence during your preferred contract type \(Winter Session, Year\-round or Summer Session\) if you apply by the application deadline\.

While we can’t guarantee you’ll receive your preferred residence or room type—assignments depend on availability—you will receive a residence space\. 

If you apply after the deadline \(Winter Session and Summer Session\) or with short notice before you begin your studies \(Year\-round and Family Housing\), we’ll do our best to accommodate you, but we cannot make any guarantees\.

To receive expedited access to housing, you must self\-identify as Indigenous in your application to study at UBC\. Student Housing receives this information from Enrolment Services and uses it when making residence offers\. 

If you have questions or to confirm we have your self\-identification in our records, please [contact us](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/)\. 

# Apply

Apply for residence by the [application deadline](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/important-dates/)\. Deadlines vary depending on whether you’re applying for Winter Session, Year\-round, Family Housing or Summer Session residence\.

In your application, you’ll provide your residence and room preferences\.  

## **Understanding the offer and assignment process** 

The way you receive your residence offer depends on which contract type you’re applying for: 

**Winter Session residence**: You’ll initially receive a generic offer that doesn’t include a specific room assignment\. Accept this offer by the deadline \(typically within 5–7 days\) to secure your housing\. We’ll email your specific room assignment later, usually in mid\-August\.

**Year\-round residence:** Depending on the time of year, you may initially receive a generic room type offer without a specific assignment, or you may receive your offer and room assignment together\. Either way, accept your offer by the deadline \(typically within 5–7 days\) to secure your housing\.

**Family Housing:** You will receive a specific unit assignment with your offer\. Respond to your offer via email by the deadline \(within 24 hours\) to confirm your interest\. You will then receive a system generated offer that you will have three days to accept to secure your housing\.

**Summer Session residence:** Depending on timing, you may initially receive a generic room type offer without a specific assignment, or you may receive your offer and room assignment together\. Either way, accept your offer by the deadline \(typically within 5–7 days\) to secure your housing\.

After you accept an offer, you’ll need to pay a deposit or first instalment of fees by the deadline indicated in your offer\. [Fees](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/fees-payments/) vary by residence area and room type\.

## Providing your residence and room preferences

In the application, we’ll ask about your preferences for residence area, room or unit type and living habits\. Depending on whether you’re applying for Winter Session, Year\-round, Family Housing or Summer Session residence, different options are available\.

Students with disabilities or ongoing health conditions can also [apply for accessible student housing](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/getting-started/accessibility/)\.

## Providing your roommate preferences

After you apply—and once you’ve received your application confirmation by email—you’ll be able to provide preferences for specific roommates in the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/)\.  

Follow the instructions in your confirmation email\. 

## Updating your application

You can update your application \(including residence, room and roommate preferences\) after submitting your application\. To update your information, visit the Application page in the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/) or [contact us](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/contact-us/) for assistance\.

# Room assignments

We assign rooms based on your preferences, application date, [age](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/applications/eligibility/#age-requirement) and what’s available\.

## Winter Session

For students moving into Winter Session residence at the start of the academic year \(i\.e\., late\-August/early\-September\), we’ll email room assignments in early to mid\-August\.

## Year\-round

For students moving into Year\-round residence, while most of our spaces become available in early May, we send offers and assignments on a rolling basis throughout the year as spaces become available\.  

## **Family Housing** 

For students moving into Student Family residence, while most of our spaces come available between May and August, we send offers and assignments on a rolling basis throughout the year\. 

## **Summer Session**

For students moving into Summer Session residence at the start of the Summer Session term \(i\.e\., May\), we’ll email room assignments in mid\-April\. 

## Contacting roommates

Once you’ve received your room assignment—or for Year\-round residence, accepted your offer and assignment—you can reach out to any roommates through the [Online Service Centre](https://secure.housing.ubc.ca/)\.

# **Housing fees and sponsorship** 

Some Indigenous students have a portion of their housing fees paid by a sponsor\. If you have a sponsor, connect with them to understand what fees are covered \(housing, meal plan or both\) and for how long \(full academic year, single term, etc\.\)\. 

Once we hear from your sponsor, we can provide documentation showing the amount due and payment methods\. Learn more about how [Student Housing sponsorship](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/?page_id=23633&preview=true) works\.

### **  

  
We’re looking for passionate, dedicated, caring UBC students who represent our diverse student community to join our vibrant team in 2026/27\.**

Working in Residence Life is a valuable way to build important leadership skills, help other students succeed socially and academically, and earn income during the school year\.

Residence Advisors inspire communities, plan events, lend an ear when needed, and—most importantly—help create lifelong memories for residents and themselves\.

  

## Student Stories

[Meet our current RAs](https://vancouver.housing.ubc.ca/jobs/student-stories/) and learn more about their experiences as Residence Advisors\.
